responsibility: This source file implements the NDS32 backend’s cost model hooks for RTL expressions and addressing modes. It provides speed- and size-oriented estimators for constants, moves, arithmetic, loads/stores, and address forms, taking into account NDS32 immediate ranges, 16-bit vs 32-bit instruction sizes, doubleword handling, and special pass behavior such as fwprop; the resulting target hooks guide combine, cse, and scheduling-related optimization decisions for this port.
